rows.cite: Senj, the same stone, same image read at 4x — «NEDA … maturantica, ŽRTVA ZRAČNOG NAPADA · ✻1924. †7.IX.1943.» A maturantica is a final-year schoolgirl. rows.name: Neda Kosina

rows.cite: Senj, the OTILIJA i NEDA KOSINA stone, read at 4x from photos/line/9000003-otilija-and-neda-kosina-gravestone-senj.jpg — «OTILIJA … čin. Velike župe · ✻1920. †11.11.1943.» Her occupation is činovnica Velike župe, a clerk of the Velika župa. THE DAY THIS ARCHIVE HAD NEVER HAD: 11 November 1943, FIVE WEEKS AFTER THE RAID that killed her father, and the stone does NOT call her a victim of it
rows.name: Otilija Kosina

rows.cite: CEMLA, the Buenos Aires port arrival books, read 21 September 2026 — «KOSINA OSCAR, 25, C, YUGOSLAVA/S.H.S., SEGKA, COLONO, 1947/10/09, PHILIPPA, GENOVA». HE ARRIVED ON 9 OCTOBER 1947, aged 25, from GENOA, on the PHILIPPA. «SEGKA» is SEGNA, the Italian name for SENJ. «COLONO» was the visa class for a post-war agricultural settler. AND «C» IS CASADO: HE WAS ALREADY MARRIED ON THE DAY HE LANDED, so the marriage this archive has been looking for in Buenos Aires happened in EUROPE. He died in Buenos Aires six years and three months later. INDEX ONLY — CEMLA's free tier gives the line and not the page
rows.name: Oskar Kosina

rows.cite: German-Croatian church press, read 21 September 2026 — «Na područje Ludwigshafena je 1958. iz Rima došao vlč. Anton Kosina», a priest of the then RIJEKA-SENJ ARCHDIOCESE, who settled near Kaiserslautern when there were only SIX Croatian priests in all of Germany; from 1967 he was voditelj of the HRVATSKA KATOLIČKA MISIJA LUDWIGSHAFEN FROM ITS FOUNDING UNTIL 1985, succeeded by fra Ljubo Sesar on 1 August 1985. Two independent outlets written for the mission's 50th anniversary in 2017: croexpress.eu «50 godina HKM Ludwigshafen» and nedjelja.ba «Ludwigshafen: 50 misijskih godina». NOT A REGISTER — a published account, and it corroborates the family's own account of Senj, Rome and Germany without having seen it
